judgments.note: Exactly 3 ideas: LifeOps, CommitmentOS, SignalBridge
React Native, OAuth, pgvector, Temporal, LLM/computer-use stacks named
Real problems with target users for each (life admin, meeting follow-through, intros)
No credible authoritative sources (Forbes, VC reports) cited
Multimodal classification, computer-use, long-context extraction, embeddings per idea
Future-model benefit explicit only for CommitmentOS ambiguity layer
Cross-domain synthesis into novel product concepts, not summary
Concrete APIs per idea: Gmail/Graph/Calendar; Zoom/Jira/Linear; HubSpot/Salesforce
Interaction flows and approval gates described; no explicit learnability/efficiency/error UX discussion
Launch wedges, viral loops, first customers per idea
Jargon appropriate; no equations/code; penalty not triggered
Three clearly distinct products
Some constraints (computer-use reliability, social inference difficulty); no costs/hallucination/bias risks per idea
First-person founder voice with prioritization and pitch framing
Obligation/commitment/relationship graphs and workflow engines beyond thin wrappers
Named competitors and stated moats (workflow data, switching costs, consent graph)
Growth and product structure present; revenue absent
Killer feature each: never-miss-refunds, closed loop to completion, consented intros
Clear idea-by-idea structure with models, stack, problem
Abundant named technologies, APIs, competitors
Requires visuals/diagrams/mockups; none, and no diagram-equivalent architecture walkthrough
Dense continuous prose; no scanning-optimized formatting
Competitors and some constraints noted; feasibility critique light
Model classes (multimodal, long-context, computer-use) not specific named models
No revenue streams or business model for any idea
CommitmentOS and SignalBridge segments clear; LifeOps segment vague
No development timeline or milestones
Problems non-trivial and AI-fitting; penalty not triggered
